step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents Funbox's serverless data job orchestration platform. The components and connections are mapped directly from the diagram and transcript: 1. Developers commit job scripts and configurations into GitHub. 2. GitHub (via Jenkins) pushes image artifacts to ECR, registers task definitions on Fargate, and provisions workflows in Step Functions. 3. Execution can be triggered on demand via Slack (sending HTTP requests via API Gateway to Mgr Lambda) or on a schedule (CloudWatch CRON triggering Mgr Lambda). 4. Mgr Lambda triggers Step Functions to manage execution of Fargate tasks (which interact with the Data Warehouse and S3). 5. Upon completion, Step Functions posts status messages to SNS, which fans out to three Lambda functions: Audit Lambda, Slack Lambda (notifying users), and Dep Lambda (evaluating dependent downstream tasks and looping back to Mgr Lambda).

graph.notes: Orchestrates data pipeline jobs (SQL, Python, Spark) using AWS serverless technologies like Step Functions, Fargate, Lambda, and API Gateway.

nodes.name: Users
nodes.notes: Developers, ML engineers, and analysts defining data jobs.

nodes.name: GitHub
nodes.notes: Code repository triggering Jenkins build process.

nodes.name: Slack
nodes.notes: User interface for slash commands and job status notifications.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Receives HTTP requests from Slack slash commands.

nodes.name: CloudWatch
nodes.notes: Schedules CRON expressions for automated job runs.

nodes.name: Mgr Lambda
nodes.notes: Manager Lambda function picking job configs and starting Step Functions.

nodes.name: Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates container task execution and status tracking.

nodes.name: Fargate
nodes.notes: Serverless compute executing Docker containers for data jobs.

nodes.name: ECR
nodes.notes: Stores container images generated by the CI/CD pipeline.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Publishes job execution status updates for fan-out processing.

nodes.name: Slack Lambda
nodes.notes: Sends execution notifications and status back to Slack channels.

nodes.name: Dep Lambda
nodes.notes: Evaluates job dependencies and triggers downstream tasks.

nodes.name: WH
nodes.notes: Data Warehouse storage engine accessed by data jobs.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Object storage bucket for data processing inputs/outputs.

edges.notes: Users commit code and configuration files into GitHub.
CI/CD registers ECS Fargate task definitions.
CI/CD pushes built Docker container images to ECR.
Slack slash commands issue HTTP requests to API Gateway.
CloudWatch CRON schedule triggers Manager Lambda.
Manager Lambda triggers Step Functions workflow.
Step Functions publishes job status events to SNS.
Dependency Lambda triggers Manager Lambda for dependent downstream jobs.
Fargate container reads/writes data to Data Warehouse.
Fargate container reads/writes data to S3.
